name: Peddler's Cart
text: Whenever you pass or swap cards, gain +15 gold.
timing: When you pass or swap cards
archetypes: Swap Meet; splash Gold Miner, Kingmaker, Nil Guard
decision: Whether to take each optional pass or swap (a Traders' Handshake swap, a partner pass), since every one now pays.
opponent: Visible gold gain; opponents who trade with you also get the card they chose.
aiNote: Take every optional pass or trade that doesn't hand an opponent a winner.
rationale: With Traders' Handshake's three swaps a round it pays about 45 gold, Nest Egg's top rate, and with a single Open Hand swap it pays 15, so it rewards committing to passing early in a run while Handshake and TE-C08 supply the contract value.
deviation: Changed from a pass-count quest to a per-pass reward, which is simpler (no counter) and is exactly "Orange gold for each completed trade" from the Swap Meet plan; per the orchestrator's ruling it pays gold only, leaving per-exchange contract value to Traders' Handshake. OR-U09 (shop gold by passes) should move further from this.
